So requests per second decide, and CPU at 200 %
only adds pods for unusually heavy requests.

div.div: From Prometheus on mk4 (evidence/prometheus.txt): the web container's CPU from cAdvisor, matched to each pod's start time, and istio_requests_total for the public Service. At the busiest minute, with 4.8 requests per second for the whole site, the busiest pod used 0.26 cores.
